nodes.name: Sklearn Basic Preprocessing Atoms
nodes.description: Function and stateless-transform decomposition for selected sklearn.preprocessing matrix transforms

nodes.name: add_dummy_feature
nodes.description: Add a leading constant-valued feature column to a dense or sparse matrix.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, value: float = 1.0) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: binarize
nodes.description: Map entries greater than a threshold to 1 and all other entries to 0.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, threshold: float = 0.0, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: binarizer_transform
nodes.description: Apply the stateless sklearn.preprocessing.Binarizer transform.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, threshold: float = 0.0, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: normalize
nodes.description: Scale rows or columns to unit l1, l2, or max norm.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, norm: str = 'l2', axis: int = 1, copy: bool = True, return_norm: bool = False) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix | tuple[NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, NDArray[np.float64]]

nodes.name: normalizer_transform
nodes.description: Apply the stateless sklearn.preprocessing.Normalizer row transform.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, norm: str = 'l2', copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: kernel_centerer_fit
nodes.description: Learn training-kernel column means and a global mean for centering kernel matrices.
nodes.type_signature: (K: NDArray[np.float64]) -> KernelCentererState

nodes.name: kernel_centerer_transform
nodes.description: Center a kernel matrix block using fitted training-kernel means.
nodes.type_signature: (K: NDArray[np.float64], state: KernelCentererState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: scale
nodes.description: Center and scale a dense or sparse dataset along an axis.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, axis: int = 0, with_mean: bool = True, with_std: bool = True, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: standard_scaler_partial_fit
nodes.description: Update fitted per-feature mean, variance, and scale statistics from one training batch.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: StandardScalerState | None = None, with_mean: bool = True, with_std: bool = True, sample_weight: NDArray[np.float64] | None = None) -> StandardScalerState

nodes.name: standard_scaler_fit
nodes.description: Fit per-feature mean, variance, and scale statistics for standardization.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, with_mean: bool = True, with_std: bool = True, sample_weight: NDArray[np.float64] | None = None) -> StandardScalerState

nodes.name: standard_scaler_transform
nodes.description: Center and scale data using fitted per-feature standardization statistics.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: StandardScalerState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: standard_scaler_inverse_transform
nodes.description: Undo fitted standard centering and variance scaling.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: StandardScalerState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: maxabs_scale
nodes.description: Scale rows or columns by their maximum absolute values without centering.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, axis: int = 0, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: maxabs_scaler_partial_fit
nodes.description: Update fitted maximum absolute values for each feature from one training batch.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: MaxAbsScalerState | None = None) -> MaxAbsScalerState

nodes.name: maxabs_scaler_fit
nodes.description: Fit maximum absolute values and scale factors for every feature.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix) -> MaxAbsScalerState

nodes.name: maxabs_scaler_transform
nodes.description: Scale each feature using fitted maximum absolute values, optionally clipping to [-1, 1].
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: MaxAbsScalerState, copy: bool = True, clip: bool = False) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: maxabs_scaler_inverse_transform
nodes.description: Undo fitted maximum-absolute-value scaling.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: MaxAbsScalerState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: minmax_scale
nodes.description: Scale rows or columns into a fixed numeric range.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64], feature_range: tuple[float, float] = (0, 1), axis: int = 0, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: minmax_scaler_partial_fit
nodes.description: Update fitted per-feature minima, maxima, ranges, and scale factors from one dense training batch.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64], feature_range: tuple[float, float] = (0, 1), state: MinMaxScalerState | None = None) -> MinMaxScalerState

nodes.name: minmax_scaler_fit
nodes.description: Fit per-feature minima, maxima, ranges, and scale factors for a dense training matrix.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64], feature_range: tuple[float, float] = (0, 1)) -> MinMaxScalerState

nodes.name: minmax_scaler_transform
nodes.description: Scale dense features into a fitted feature range, optionally clipping held-out values.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64], state: MinMaxScalerState, copy: bool = True, clip: bool = False) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: minmax_scaler_inverse_transform
nodes.description: Undo fitted min-max feature-range scaling.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64], state: MinMaxScalerState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: robust_scaler_fit
nodes.description: Fit robust per-feature medians and quantile-range scale factors.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, with_centering: bool = True, with_scaling: bool = True, quantile_range: tuple[float, float] = (25.0, 75.0), unit_variance: bool = False) -> RobustScalerState

nodes.name: robust_scaler_transform
nodes.description: Center and scale data using fitted robust per-feature statistics.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: RobustScalerState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: robust_scaler_inverse_transform
nodes.description: Undo fitted robust centering and quantile-range scaling.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: RobustScalerState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: robust_scale
nodes.description: Center by median and scale by quantile range along rows or columns.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, axis: int = 0, with_centering: bool = True, with_scaling: bool = True, quantile_range: tuple[float, float] = (25.0, 75.0), copy: bool = True, unit_variance: bool = False) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: label_encoder_fit
nodes.description: Learn sorted unique target-label classes for integer encoding.
nodes.type_signature: (y: NDArray[np.object_] | list[object] | tuple[object, ...]) -> LabelEncoderState

nodes.name: label_binarize
nodes.description: Encode fixed target classes as one-vs-all indicator columns.
nodes.type_signature: (y: NDArray[np.object_] | list[object] | tuple[object, ...] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, classes: NDArray[np.object_] | list[object] | tuple[object, ...], neg_label: int = 0, pos_label: int = 1, sparse_output: bool = False) -> NDArray[np.int_] | scipy.sparse.csr_matrix

nodes.name: label_binarizer_fit
nodes.description: Learn target classes, target type, and sparse-input mode for label binarization.
nodes.type_signature: (y: NDArray[np.object_] | list[object] | tuple[object, ...] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, neg_label: int = 0, pos_label: int = 1, sparse_output: bool = False) -> LabelBinarizerState

nodes.name: label_binarizer_fit_transform
nodes.description: Learn label-binarizer state and transform labels to one-vs-all indicators.
nodes.type_signature: (y: NDArray[np.object_] | list[object] | tuple[object, ...] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, neg_label: int = 0, pos_label: int = 1, sparse_output: bool = False) -> tuple[LabelBinarizerState, NDArray[np.int_] | scipy.sparse.csr_matrix]

nodes.name: label_binarizer_transform
nodes.description: Transform labels to one-vs-all indicators using fitted label-binarizer state.
nodes.type_signature: (y: NDArray[np.object_] | list[object] | tuple[object, ...] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: LabelBinarizerState) -> NDArray[np.int_] | scipy.sparse.csr_matrix

nodes.name: label_binarizer_inverse_transform
nodes.description: Map indicator scores back to original labels using fitted label-binarizer state.
nodes.type_signature: (Y: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: LabelBinarizerState, threshold: float | None = None) -> NDArray[np.object_] | scipy.sparse.csr_matrix

nodes.name: label_encoder_fit_transform
nodes.description: Learn target-label classes and encode labels to integer class positions in one pass.
nodes.type_signature: (y: NDArray[np.object_] | list[object] | tuple[object, ...]) -> tuple[LabelEncoderState, NDArray[np.int_]]

nodes.name: label_encoder_transform
nodes.description: Map target labels to fitted integer class positions.
nodes.type_signature: (y: NDArray[np.object_] | list[object] | tuple[object, ...], state: LabelEncoderState) -> NDArray[np.int_]

nodes.name: label_encoder_inverse_transform
nodes.description: Map fitted integer class positions back to original target labels.
nodes.type_signature: (y: NDArray[np.int_] | list[int] | tuple[int, ...], state: LabelEncoderState) -> NDArray[np.object_]

nodes.name: multi_label_binarizer_fit
nodes.description: Learn class ordering and sparse-output mode for multilabel indicator encoding.
nodes.type_signature: (y: Iterable[Iterable[object]], classes: NDArray[np.object_] | list[object] | tuple[object, ...] | None = None, sparse_output: bool = False) -> MultiLabelBinarizerState

nodes.name: multi_label_binarizer_fit_transform
nodes.description: Learn multilabel class ordering and transform label sets to binary indicators.
nodes.type_signature: (y: Iterable[Iterable[object]], classes: NDArray[np.object_] | list[object] | tuple[object, ...] | None = None, sparse_output: bool = False) -> tuple[MultiLabelBinarizerState, NDArray[np.int_] | scipy.sparse.csr_matrix]

nodes.name: multi_label_binarizer_transform
nodes.description: Transform iterable label sets to a binary indicator matrix using fitted class ordering.
nodes.type_signature: (y: Iterable[Iterable[object]], state: MultiLabelBinarizerState) -> NDArray[np.int_] | scipy.sparse.csr_matrix

nodes.name: multi_label_binarizer_inverse_transform
nodes.description: Convert a multilabel indicator matrix back to tuples of class labels.
nodes.type_signature: (yt: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: MultiLabelBinarizerState) -> list[tuple[object, ...]]

nodes.name: polynomial_features_fit
nodes.description: Learn polynomial exponent rows and output-feature count for a fitted input width.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, degree: int | tuple[int, int] = 2, interaction_only: bool = False, include_bias: bool = True, order: str = 'C') -> PolynomialFeaturesState

nodes.name: polynomial_features_transform
nodes.description: Expand rows into fitted polynomial and interaction feature columns.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: PolynomialFeaturesState) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: polynomial_features_fit_transform
nodes.description: Learn polynomial exponent rows and expand rows in one pass.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, degree: int | tuple[int, int] = 2, interaction_only: bool = False, include_bias: bool = True, order: str = 'C') -> tuple[PolynomialFeaturesState, NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix]

nodes.name: power_transformer_fit
nodes.description: Estimate per-feature Box-Cox or Yeo-Johnson lambdas and optional standardization statistics.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, method: str = 'yeo-johnson', standardize: bool = True) -> PowerTransformerState

nodes.name: power_transformer_transform
nodes.description: Apply fitted power-transform lambdas and optional standardization to feature columns.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: PowerTransformerState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: power_transformer_inverse_transform
nodes.description: Undo fitted standardization and inverse Box-Cox or Yeo-Johnson feature transforms.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: PowerTransformerState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: power_transformer_fit_transform
nodes.description: Estimate per-feature power-transform lambdas and transform the same data in one pass.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, method: str = 'yeo-johnson', standardize: bool = True, copy: bool = True) -> tuple[PowerTransformerState, NDArray[np.float64]]

nodes.name: power_transform
nodes.description: Fit per-feature power-transform lambdas and return transformed features without exposing state.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, method: str = 'yeo-johnson', standardize: bool = True, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: quantile_transformer_fit
nodes.description: Estimate empirical per-feature quantiles for fitted distribution mapping.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, n_quantiles: int = 1000, output_distribution: str = 'uniform', ignore_implicit_zeros: bool = False, subsample: int | None = 10000, random_state: int | numpy.random.RandomState | None = None) -> QuantileTransformerState

nodes.name: quantile_transformer_transform
nodes.description: Map features through fitted empirical quantiles to uniform or normal marginals.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: QuantileTransformerState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: quantile_transformer_inverse_transform
nodes.description: Map quantile-transformed values back to the fitted original feature scale.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: QuantileTransformerState, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: quantile_transformer_fit_transform
nodes.description: Estimate empirical quantiles and transform the same matrix in one pass.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, n_quantiles: int = 1000, output_distribution: str = 'uniform', ignore_implicit_zeros: bool = False, subsample: int | None = 10000, random_state: int | numpy.random.RandomState | None = None, copy: bool = True) -> tuple[QuantileTransformerState, NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix]

nodes.name: quantile_transform
nodes.description: Fit empirical quantiles on one axis and return transformed values without exposing state.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, axis: int = 0, n_quantiles: int = 1000, output_distribution: str = 'uniform', ignore_implicit_zeros: bool = False, subsample: int | None = 100000, random_state: int | numpy.random.RandomState | None = None, copy: bool = True) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: kbins_discretizer_fit
nodes.description: Learn per-feature bin edges for continuous-feature discretization.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, n_bins: int | NDArray[np.int_] | list[int] | tuple[int, ...] = 5, encode: str = 'onehot', strategy: str = 'quantile', quantile_method: str = 'warn', dtype: type | None = None, subsample: int | None = 200000, random_state: int | numpy.random.RandomState | None = None, sample_weight: NDArray[np.float64] | None = None) -> KBinsDiscretizerState

nodes.name: kbins_discretizer_transform
nodes.description: Discretize features into fitted ordinal or one-hot bins.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: KBinsDiscretizerState) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: kbins_discretizer_inverse_transform
nodes.description: Map fitted ordinal or one-hot bins back to bin centers.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, state: KBinsDiscretizerState) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: kbins_discretizer_fit_transform
nodes.description: Learn discretization bins and transform the same matrix.
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix, n_bins: int | NDArray[np.int_] | list[int] | tuple[int, ...] = 5, encode: str = 'onehot', strategy: str = 'quantile', quantile_method: str = 'warn', dtype: type | None = None, subsample: int | None = 200000, random_state: int | numpy.random.RandomState | None = None, sample_weight: NDArray[np.float64] | None = None) -> tuple[KBinsDiscretizerState, NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix]
